description: This file contains the implementation of the XxHash32 non-cryptographic hashing algorithm, including methods for computing hashes with optional seeds, appending data, resetting the state, and producing final hash values.
published: TryHash(ReadOnlySpan<byte> source, Span<byte> destination, out int bytesWritten, int seed = 0)

classes.name: XxHash32
classes.description: Implementation of the XxHash32 algorithm, a non-cryptographic hash function providing methods for hashing data with optional seed support and internal state management.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash computation to its initial state, preparing for a new hash operation.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the current hash computation, processing 16-byte stripes when possible and managing leftover data.

methods.name: GetCurrentHashCore
methods.description: Produces the current hash value based on the accumulated data without altering internal state.
